standard_prerequisites.use: Turns a flat resolution of length d into the bound on tor dimension.

standard_prerequisites.name: The truncation of a projective resolution in degrees at least minus d is a flat resolution of length d

core_obligations: Derive the bound on tor dimension from a flat resolution of length d (proof lines 17013-17015).
Take a projective resolution and truncate it to obtain a flat resolution of length d (proof lines 17016-17020).
Record the case d equal to zero as the characterisation of flatness (proof lines 17021-17022).
proof_roadmap: Resolution gives the tor bound (proof lines 17013-17015).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises tor dimension at most d by the existence of a length d resolution by flat modules, with the case d equal to zero recovering flatness. One direction reads the resolution as a complex concentrated in the indicated degrees and applies the tor amplitude criterion. The converse takes a projective resolution and truncates it in degrees at least minus d, which by the earlier result on the last term of a resolution is a flat resolution of length d.
